title: Waker Leak (Lost Wakeups)
pattern: Returning `Poll::Pending` from a custom `Future` implementation without storing or coordinating with the `cx.waker()`.
why_bad: It violates the core contract of the `Future` poll model. If a future returns `Pending` without registering the waker to be triggered upon resource readiness, the future will sleep forever, causing a permanent lost wakeup and hang.
detection: A custom `poll` implementation returning `Poll::Pending` where `cx.waker()` is not cloned, stored, or passed to a child future.
counterexample: The future delegates the polling to an inner future which is guaranteed to register the waker.
